native_retrieval.title: Direct Tax Alert
native_retrieval.snippet: 2 [2022] 138 taxmann.com 64 (SC) • The taxpayer filed a writ before the Bombay High Court challenging validity of the notice issued under section 148 and re-assessment proceedings. High Court ruling • Based on the Faceless Assessment Scheme introduced by the CBDT6, FAO is required to issue the notice under section 148 and not the JAO. Issue 4 - Whether re-assessment proceedings can be initiated based on change of opinion High Court ruling • The claim of deduction under Section 80JJAA was disclosed in the Tax audit report of the taxpayer. Tata 2020 (‘TOLA’) are applicable to AYs 2015-16 and onwards High Court ruling • TOLA provisions are applicable only to the AYs for which the time limit for issue of notice under section 148 was expiring on or before March 31, 2021.
